prompt: Two seasons after Demar Derozan was traded to the San Antonio Spurs, who was the leading scorer for the fifth place team in the Western Conference?
answer: DeMar DeRozan was traded to the Spurs in 2018. Two seasons later, in the 2020–21 season, the fifth-place Western Conference team was the **Dallas Mavericks**, whose leading scorer was **Luka Dončić**.
